G. 10,000-1-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

SUPPLEMENTARY
The following is the statement of Hsu Ah Foo ( 徐阿福 ), Chauffeur employed with Taylor Garage,
native of ____________________ taken by me D.I.Ross
at 9 a.m. on the 5.8.31 and interpreted by D.I.Kuh

The foreigner who engaged the car on the morning of June 1, arrived at the garage on foot. He was wearing a brown coloured jacket and a white topee. He was alone and carried no luggage. The only time I saw him carrying a bag was when he left No.96 Boone Road at about 7 a.m. in company with a foreign woman. It was of a brownish colour.

After engaging the car the foreigner instructed me to go to Boone Road and told me in English, to proceed via the following roads; Burkill, Park, Bubbling Well, Nanking, Szechuen, Peking, Museum, Chapeo to Boone Road. He did not stop at the Palace Hotel or any other place enroute.

When he left No.96 Boone Road and proceeded to Shanghai North Station, he was still dressed in the same clothes.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

警方调查报告。

补充
以下为本人巡官罗斯于31年8月5日上午9时，由巡官库赫（D.I. Kuh）担任翻译，从泰勒汽车行（Taylor Garage）雇佣的司机徐阿福（籍贯 ____________________ ）处取得的陈述。

6月1日上午租用汽车的外国人步行到达车行。他身穿棕色夹克，头戴白色热带盔帽。他独自一人，未携带行李。我唯一一次见他携带皮包，是他在早上7点左右与一名外国妇女一同离开北四川路96号时。皮包呈褐色。

外国人租好车后，指示我前往北四川路，并用英语告诉我经由以下道路行驶：伯基尔路（Burkill）、公园路（Park）、静安寺路（Bubbling Well）、南京路（Nanking）、四川路（Szechuen）、北京路（Peking）、博物院路（Museum）、闸北（Chapeo）至北四川路。途中他未在汇中饭店（Palace Hotel）或任何其他地点停留。

当他离开北四川路96号前往上海北站时，仍穿着同样的衣服。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
REPORT
Date July 13, 19 31.

Subject (in full) Motor-Car "Chit", issued by the Taylor Garage bearing the
date June 3, 1931, purporting to have been signed by
W.J. Hey-Thorburn.

Made by D.S.I. Montgomery Forwarded by Henry Robertson esq.

Inquiries into the above matter show that the
attached green motor-car 'chit' was issued by the Horse Bazaar
Branch of the Taylor Garage, at about 6 a.m. on June 1, 1931 and the
front of the "chit" bears that date, the impression having been
faintly made by a stamping clock. Subsequently, the "chit" was
stamped three times on the reverse side by the Astor Road
Branch of the above garage, whose stamping clock, owing to some
irregularity, was incorrectly dated.
It appears that at about 6 a.m. on June 1, 1931 a
foreigner who is described as being of slight build, though
rather tall, of Portuguese appearance, dressed in brown clothes,
presented himself at the Horse Bazaar 126 Bubbling Well Road,
and ordered a car. He was allotted Motor Car No, 12104, driven by
one Hsu Ah-foo (徐阿虎), (Licence No F. 6374), residing at 3
Yong Ka Jao (康家桥), off Jessfield Road. The foreigner
instructed the chauffeur to drive him to 96 Boone Road and on
arrival there, alighted and calling for the 'chit', signed it
and under the signature wrote "T 46", at the same time writing
on reverse side "Come back at 7.00 a.m. W.J.H.T.". After
instructing the chauffeur verbally to return at 7 a.m., the
foreigner went inside the building.
The driver then proceeded to the Astor Road Branch
where he handed the 'chit' into the office. There it was placed
in the stamping clock and an impression made in the reverse
right hand corner. A further inscription was made in pencil
"Astor Road Branch IN A.M. 6.22 " (It is to be noted that the
times, according to the clock stamps do not tally with the
pencilled notes. This is explained by the clock being out of
order and the pencilled notes may be taken as approximately

主题（全称）泰勒汽车行（Taylor Garage）出具的、日期为1931年6月3日、声称由W.J. 海-索伯恩（W.J. Hey-Thorburn）签署的汽车“单据”（Chit）。

由 副巡官蒙哥马利（D.S.I. Montgomery）制作，由亨利·罗伯逊先生（Henry Robertson esq.）转呈。

对上述事项的调查显示，
所附的绿色汽车“单据”系由泰勒汽车行马霍路（Horse Bazaar，即今黄陂北路附近）分行于1931年6月1日上午6点左右出具，
“单据”正面印有该日期，印记由打卡钟轻微盖印而成。随后，该“单据”在上述车行的阿斯特路（Astor Road）分行背面被盖印三次，由于某种故障，该分行的打卡钟日期显示错误。
据悉，1931年6月1日上午6点左右，一名身材瘦小但较高、具有葡萄牙人外貌、身穿棕色衣服的外国人出现在静安寺路126号的马霍路分行，并预订了一辆汽车。他被分配乘坐第12104号汽车，由徐阿虎（Hsu Ah-foo，执照号 F. 6374）驾驶，徐居住在极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road，即今万航渡路）附近的康家桥3号。该外国人指示司机送他去北四川路96号，到达那里后，他下车并索要“单据”，在单据上签名，并在签名下方写下“T 46”，同时在背面写上“上午7:00回来。W.J.H.T.”。在口头指示司机上午7点返回后，该外国人进入大楼内。
司机随后前往阿斯特路分行，将“单据”交入办公室。在那里，单据被放入打卡钟，在背面右上角盖印。另用铅笔加注“阿斯特路分行 上午 6.22 ”（值得注意的是，根据打卡钟显示的时间与铅笔笔记不符。这是因为时钟出现故障，铅笔笔记可视为大致

In order to be at 96, Boone Road in good time the
car was dispatched from the garage at 6-50 a.m., the "chit"
again being stamped on the reverse side, in the middle, and
a pencilled inscription made, "OUT a.m. 6-50". On arrival at
the above address the chauffeur waited until about 7-5 a.m.
when the foreigner came out carrying a suitcase and accompanied
by a foreign woman, who is described as being of slight build.
Ordering the chauffeur to drive them to the North Railway
Station both persons got into the car and on arrival there
both alighted and went inside the Station, telling the driver
to wait, which he did on Boundary Road, as his car did not
have a Chinese licence.
At about 7.30 a.m. the foreign woman returned alone
and ordered the chauffeur to drive her to 315, rue Bourgeat,
the residence of Hay-Thorburn, Senior and his son. The
chauffeur not knowing the exact location of the house went
about 25 yards past the door, where he brought the car to a
standstill. The passenger then got out of the car and went to
the house and without entering, handed a letter to Mr. Hay-
Thorburn Senior and returned to the car immediately. This
information is corroborated by Mr. Thorburn who states that
the letter was handed to him at about 7.50 a.m. June 1, 1931
by a Mrs. W.P. Roberts, Flat No. 6, 96 Boone Road, The
letter is mentioned in the original report of young Thorburn's
disappearance, dated June 1, 1931.
From No 315 rue Burgeat, the chauffeur was ordered to
drive back to 96 Boone Road and on arrival there handed the
"chit" to the foreign woman who wrote on the front "time 15

为了及时到达北四川路96号，
汽车于上午6:50从车行发出，“单据”
再次在背面中部盖印，
并用铅笔加注“OUT a.m. 6-50”（上午6:50外出）。到达上述地址后，司机等待至约上午7:05，
此时该外国人提着手提箱出来，并由一名身材瘦小的外国妇女陪同。
两人命令司机送他们去北站，随即上车，到达后两人下车进入车站，告诉司机等候，司机便在界路（Boundary Road，即今天目东路）等候，因为他的车没有中国牌照。
约上午7:30，该外国妇女独自返回，命令司机送她去布尔热路315号（315, rue Bourgeat），即老海-索伯恩（Hay-Thorburn, Senior）及其儿子的住所。
司机因不知确切的门牌位置，驶过门口约25码处停下。乘客随后下车走向房屋，并未进入，而是将一封信交给老海-索伯恩先生，并立即返回车内。此信息得到索伯恩先生的证实，他表示该信是由北四川路96号6室的W.P. 罗伯茨夫人（Mrs. W.P. Roberts）于1931年6月1日上午7:50左右交给他的。
这封信在小索伯恩失踪的原始报告（日期为1931年6月1日）中曾被提及。
从布尔热路315号，司机奉命返回北四川路96号，到达后将
“单据”交给该外国妇女，她在正面写下“时间八点十五分

past eight", the car then being dismissed and the driver
receiving a gratuity. The chauffeur then proceeded to the
Astor Road Branch and handed in the "chit" and reported the
